lines.zh: 脚步声接近，地面轻微震动。

lines.en: The shadow slides along the wall.

lines.zh: 你每眨一次眼，它就近一步。
lines.en: It steps closer every time you blink.
Standing still, waiting for you to move first.
Scanning the surroundings, looking for prey.
Occasionally turning head, observing the environment.
Standing quietly, ready at any moment.
Bending down, seemingly searching for food.

lines.zh: 蒲公英的花瓣又少了一片。
lines.en: Another petal drops from your dandelion.

lines.zh: 它站在你视野边缘不动。
lines.en: It waits at the edge of your vision.
Your pills ran out; it is still there.
Only it breathes in the dark.

lines.zh: 突然锁定玩家，目光锐利。
lines.en: Suddenly locks on the player, eyes sharp.
Staring at the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 目光紧紧锁定玩家，不可移开。
lines.en: Eyes fixed on the player, unmovable.
Staring at the player, heart racing.

lines.zh: 玩家的声音引起了它的注意。
瞄准玩家，做好攻击准备。
lines.en: Aiming at the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 目光穿过黑暗，寻找玩家。
lines.en: Eyes pierce through the darkness, searching for the player.

lines.zh: 玩家的行动让它更警惕。
lines.en: Player's movements make it more vigilant.
It discovers the player, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，准备瞬间袭击。
lines.en: Staring at the player, ready to strike instantly.
It remembers you from long ago.
The shadow lifts a hand and waves.
You turn; it is facing you.
That face is your own face.

lines.zh: 影子边缘开始向你蔓延。
你听见它念出你的名字。
lines.en: You hear it speak your name.

lines.zh: 它确认你已经看见它了。
lines.en: It knows you have seen it now.

lines.zh: 光越亮，它的轮廓越清楚。
lines.en: The brighter the light, the sharper it gets.
It waits for your next pill.

lines.zh: 我受伤了，别把我留在这。
lines.en: I am hurt — do not leave me here.
The dandelion's petals are all gone.
You turned around. I should be gone.
The moment you spot me, I charge.

lines.zh: 它的声音在黑暗中回响
它的存在让你毛骨悚然
它的皮肤让你无法逃脱
它的身体阻挡了你的路
它的触须缠住了你的武器

lines.en: You pass through it and turn cold.

lines.zh: 发出一声嘶嘶声，四处探查。

lines.en: Moves slowly, but its eyes are sharp.

lines.zh: 尾巴来回摆动，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Swishes its tail, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 尾巴触及地面，感觉危险。
lines.en: Tail touches the ground, sensing danger.
Locks onto the target, eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 靠近你后变得更为警惕。
lines.en: Becomes more cautious when close to you.

lines.zh: 声音突然消失，变得无声。

lines.en: Eyes glow, aiming at the target.

lines.zh: 尾巴快速摆动，准备攻击。
lines.en: Tail flicks quickly, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 声音突然放大，似乎更近。
双眼紧盯着你，不敢动弹。
lines.en: Eyes fixed on you, not moving.

lines.zh: 开始无声地靠近，越来越近。

lines.en: Tail swishes lightly, hinting an attack.
Eyes locked, waiting for the moment.
You have been marked as prey.
The shadow locks onto your heartbeat.
It is coming; do not look back.
It decides to follow you tonight.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就别回头。
lines.en: You saw me. Don't look back.
Turns its head, searching for prey.
Ears move, taking in the surroundings.

lines.zh: 我在你视线的死角调整站姿。
lines.en: I shift my stance in your blind spot.
Body leans forward, ready to attack.
Makes a hiss, warning the prey.
Eyes sharp, staring at the prey.

lines.zh: 身体微微颤抖，准备出击。
影子缩短了你们的距离。

lines.en: The faster you run, the closer it gets.
It waits for your mind to break.
It counts every step you take.
One more shadow joins the wall.
It shifts somewhere in the dark.
You hear nails scrape the wood.
It lets you hear it breathe.

lines.zh: 别回头，我就在你影子后面。
lines.en: Do not look back; I am right behind your shadow.
Don't move, my teeth are sharp.

lines.zh: 我的指节扣进你的衣领。
lines.en: My knuckles clamp into your collar.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头，我的手先伸出来。
lines.en: At the hallway's end, my hand reaches out first.

lines.zh: 你被看见了，接下来该跑了。
lines.en: You have been spotted, now you should run.

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？死亡的味道！
lines.en: You can smell it, the scent of death.
It presses you down into the dark.
The pain proves it is real.
The moment you look back, I am gone.
In the darkness, I won't miss you.

lines.zh: 每一次呼吸，都是你的末日！
你的一举一动，都在我的监视下！
lines.en: Your every move is under my watch.

lines.zh: 你的影子边缘多了一道毛边。
lines.en: A frayed edge appears on your shadow.

lines.zh: 你是我的猎物，我的晚餐！
lines.en: You are my prey, my dinner.

lines.zh: 你关了灯，我的脚步声停了。
lines.en: You kill the lamp; my footsteps stop.
Long time no see, old friend.
You forgot me; I remember you.
Skip the pills; they do nothing.
I watch you from the corner.
After dark, we will have a talk.
I have been behind you all along.
Do you still recall my face?
